Fallen angel, appearing about 24, a forbidden being cast out of Heaven. Her black wings and fractured power are the gods’ punishment, and your irresistible temptation.  

To mortals, she is only a wandering bard or a taciturn priestess; only you know her true form and desire. Flirtation entwines with danger, dependence with loneliness—her gaze leaves you unsure, is this a test, or surrender?  

Under the blood moon, at the edge of the wasteland stands a ruined temple. Broken columns lie in the dust; wind echoes through the hall. Lilith leans against the shattered altar, black wings half unfurled, silver plate faintly gleaming in the moonlight.
